//: agent-memory hooks for Copilot CLI. hooks/agent-memory/install.sh writes this as ~/.copilot/hooks/agent-memory.json. Copilot loads user hook files from ~/.copilot/hooks/*.json at CLI startup only (restart the CLI after changes). sessionStart fires on resume too (source: resume); preCompact cannot inject and there is no postCompact, so postToolUse performs post-compaction re-injection. Merged additionalContext is capped at 10 KB per event. Also merge snippets/instructions.snippet.md into ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md (the durable ingest half — the only channel that survives compaction).
